lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly horizontal rows across the lateral flank, with the largest clusters located in the central region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity that align with and intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with light values on the superior edge and dark values on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Small, high-luminance blobs distributed across the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, appearing with greater density and smaller diameter than those on the main flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A large remora is attached to the dorsal surface near the midline; a school of small fish is present in the lower-left foreground.
